conventions.frames: 1-based; loops repeat their first key as the last key (keep it, UE loops seamlessly)
conventions.car_forward: nose points +Y in mesh space; the car always drives BACKWARDS, so rotate the mesh component Yaw 90 so the tail points along the actor's +X (verify with the arrow)
conventions.car_left_right: L/R = the direction the car's path bends, seen in the direction of travel
conventions.rider_direction: _B/_L/_R = where the player is relative to the rider (behind/left/right); for Damage/Death it is where the hit comes from

rider_socket.note: bone points up; create a Skeleton Socket on it rotated 90 deg so the rider sits upright facing the camel's head (check with a Preview Asset)

driver.note: socket bone has identity rest axes in Blender; verify with a Preview Asset that the driver faces the bonnet (he leans out of the window in every clip), rotate the socket if needed; every one-shot starts and ends on frame 1 of Drive_A
driver.screen_right: the driver's window side (+X of the car = screen right in the game camera at the car's nose)
driver.throws: left hand; show SK_BeerCan_Driver from the can_show event (frame 4) to the release event, then spawn SM_BeerCan there with the velocity the game wants
driver.sync: Idle_*/Drive_* are 48 frames @24fps like the car's Car_Idle/Car_Drive loops (sync group CarLoop)

conventions.sync_groups: CamelStride: all rider Ride* loops and camel Run loops are 18 frames @30fps; Steer: car Drive/Turn* share length, wheel spin and road bumps
conventions.units: entries with "units": "cm" (Passenger, Pharaoh, Guards, from 15 Nov) are centimetre FBX: UnitScaleFactor 1, NO factor 100 on the root bone, import at uniform scale 1.0 like the rest. Entries without it (cars, riders, camels, driver) are the older metre files with the factor 100 on the root, unchanged.
conventions.root_travel: clips with "root_travel": true carry their flight/fall on the root bone (pharaoh Death_R/L, guards Fall_Off). Keep Enable Root Motion OFF so the travel plays visually; give the mesh a large Bounds Scale (or a physics asset) so it is not culled while far from the actor. Every other new clip keeps the root still.

pharaoh.attach_to: the throne actor (Pharao_Throne): same location, rotation and SAME scale (throne and pharaoh are both authored 1:1 at 1 m)
pharaoh.faces: Blender -Y = UE mesh +Y like the mannequin; turn the actor to face the player
pharaoh.base_pose: Sit_Idle frame 1; every one-shot starts on it and Cast_End/Taunt_Flex/Flinch end on it
pharaoh.cast: play Cast then Cast_End; spawn the spell at Cast's spell_peak (its last frame)
pharaoh.deaths: Death_R flies to screen right, Death_L to screen left; both end mid-fall about 3.6 m below the throne: hide or despawn him there

guards.meshes: Guard2 = royal_guard_2 (main), Guard1 = royal_guard_1 (bonus); same 6 clips; each has its OWN skeleton asset
guards.pivot: root on the deck between the feet; stands on the chariot deck
guards.scale: proposed: the pharaoh/throne actor scale x1.25 so they tower over the seated pharaoh [to confirm with Nils]
guards.throw: grabs a projectile off the deck with both hands (grab), releases it from hand_r (release); the game spawns the projectile (a rock unless Nils says otherwise [to confirm])
guards.fall_off: travels 4.4 m back on the root and ends lying face-down at deck height; no return to Idle
